conventions.convention: Natural units c = ℏ = 1; metric diag(−1,1,1,1); charge labels (n_e,n_m) ∈ Z²; scalar central charge z = √2(n_e a + n_m a_D). Periods, central charge and mass have mass dimension one.
The DSZ pairing is 2(n_m n′_e − n_e n′_m). Monopole (0,1) and dyon (1,−1) have ordered pairing +2, matching two arrows from dyon to monopole.

Ω is −1/2 times the supplied-basis trace of (−1)^(2J₃)(2J₃)² on a supplied massive BPS sector; the operator must be bounded and trace class. Ω is zero off the selected stable support. This is distinct from the Witten heat supertrace and from finite-field groupoid weights.

After one common phase rotation, charges used in products lie strictly in the upper half-plane; phase is principal argument divided by π. Products have largest phase leftmost, with lexicographic charge order within equal phases. Zero charge has no phase.

Hall multiplication counts embedded subobjects first. The skew Euler form is χ(d,e) − χ(e,d), integration includes t^χ(d,d), and x^d * x^e = t^(−〈e,d〉)x^(d+e), with t the specified positive number √q.

The physical cone is pointed and has a positive additive degree with finite sublevel sets. The charge map preserves degree and pairing. The coefficient field Q(t) means Q(√q), and the continuous per-phase factor-matching homomorphism Θ is an additional assumed bridge, not a consequence of Hall invariance.
Countable Choice is assumed through the trace and BPS suppliers; Hilbert bases are supplied as data. The finite-field enumeration itself is choice-free.

load_bearing.statement: Conditional pure-SU(2) charge data consist of the source-normalized periods and central charge, the specified DSZ pairing, supplied massive stable BPS sectors and trace-class second-helicity operators, and phase, wall, chamber and positive-degree cone conventions. The definition asserts neither sector existence nor a Hall-index identification.

For the two specified regular points, under the stated finite-acyclic-quiver, upper-half-plane, cone-support, integral-index, degree, pairing and coefficient hypotheses, and an exact continuous homomorphism Θ matching every integrated Hall phase factor with the corresponding ordered physical KS factors, S(u₋) = S(u₊). Neither existence of that bridge nor a continuum QFT construction is asserted.

concerns.concern: The Definition supplies a rest-fiber Hilbert sector 'carrying the selected unitary ... super-Poincaré representation at rest momentum' and defines its little-group action as U(g,0) restricted to that fiber. The cited representation definition supplies U on the full Hilbert space, without a fiberwise restriction construction. An abstract rest fiber needs its own supplied little-group representation; it is generally not a normalizable fixed-momentum subspace. Under the literal subspace reading, a nonzero rest-momentum eigenvector and its images under arbitrarily small nontrivial boosts have distinct momentum eigenvalues and are orthogonal, contradicting strong continuity. The earlier central-charge theorem explicitly distinguishes abstract fibers from normalizable subspaces. Clarify which fiber action is supplied and type the restriction accordingly.
